references.text: The Lord's command to set up the lamps so that they shine forward, the original instruction that Moses followed.
Aaron and his sons shall keep the lamps burning before the Lord from evening until morning, a perpetual statute.
Aaron shall light the lamps at twilight, a continual offering of incense for the Lord throughout all generations.
Instructions to keep the lamps burning continuously on the pure lampstand before the Lord.
Aaron sets up the lamps so that they shine forward from the lampstand, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
The Levites keep the Lord's statutes and light the lamps on the golden lampstand every evening, in contrast to those who have fallen away.
A direct narrative parallel confirming that Aaron set up the lampstand exactly according to the Lord's command.
A summarizing verse confirming that the entire setting up of the tabernacle (including the lampstand) was done according to the Lord's command.
The same event (the setting up of the tabernacle); shows consistency in obedience to all God's instructions.
